verdict.rationale: The only first-party feature close to this story is Pipecat Evals. It runs a described conversation against your real agent and reports whether the expected behavior still holds, which flags failures in test conversations rather than reviewing your actual calls. Recording, transcript collection and metrics provide raw material for a do-it-yourself review pipeline, but nothing in the evidence shows automatic AI review of real calls. Missing for 10: automatic AI review of production calls, quality scoring, resolution analysis, and any independent corroboration.
